value.rationale: Run occupancy and trap energy are physically meaningful and separately measurable. A strict all-lag directional inequality reveals causal motility-to-energy storage that equal-time densities and the reversible two-state run clock alone cannot detect. The exact transform, integrated strength, and thermal diffusion invariance supply a robust analytical benchmark for finite-pause active motion. The equal-rate case yields a closed optimal observation lag; no downstream theorem is required for this structural nonequilibrium diagnostic.
